# Financial Metrics Dashboard \-- Technical Feasibility & Architecture

## 1\. Project Scope

A single-user financial metrics dashboard with the following confirmed requirements:

- **Layout:** Multi-panel dashboard inspired by Koyfin  
- **Metrics (\~40–60 across six categories):**  
  - **Stock Market:** S\&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow Jones, VIX, market breadth, top 10 by market cap, top 10 daily gainers/losers, watchlist  
  - **Cryptocurrency:** BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA, XRP  
  - **Commodities:** gold, silver, copper, oil (Brent), crude oil, natural gas  
  - **Macro/US:** GDP, CPI, unemployment, federal funds rate, yield curve, treasury rates  
  - **Credit/Liquidity:** high yield spreads, yield curve  
  - **Housing:** mortgage rates, home prices, retail sales, consumer sentiment  
- **Refresh cadence:** Per-minute during market hours  
- **Historical depth:** 30–50 years of daily history (per-minute intraday history is more constrained \-- see §7)  
- **Drill-down:** Per-ticker detail pages with full stat panel and time-range chart (1D / 5D / 1M / 6M / YTD / 1Y / 5Y / MAX)  
- **AI features:**  
  - LLM chatbot for ad-hoc analysis of dashboard data  
  - Scheduled morning \+ afternoon AI summary paragraphs  
- **Compliance posture:** Informational only \-- no investment-advice logic  
- **Auth:** Single user, password-gated (no multi-user / no public access)

## 2\. Architecture

**Data flow:**

1. Vercel Cron jobs poll providers per minute during market hours  
2. Postgres stores time-series \+ watchlist \+ summary archive  
3. UI reads from Postgres (low-latency); LLM reads context from Postgres for chat/summaries  
4. Two scheduled jobs (morning \+ afternoon) generate AI summary paragraphs and persist them

## 3\. Recommended Tech Stack

| Layer | Choice | Rationale |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Frontend \+ backend | Next.js 16 (App Router) | Single-codebase fullstack, mature, Vercel-native |
| Hosting | Vercel Pro | Required for sub-daily cron frequency; standard Next.js host |
| Database | Supabase Postgres | Vercel-paired Postgres replacement after Vercel Postgres → Neon migration in 2025 |
| Time-series storage | Plain Postgres tables | Data volume (\~50 metrics × daily × 50 yr ≈ 900K rows) does not require TimescaleDB |
| Charts | TradingView Lightweight Charts (canvas, 45 KB, 60 FPS) for price/historical; Recharts for low-density widgets | Performance-grade charting suited for financial visualization |
| UI components | shadcn/ui \+ Tailwind CSS | Design flexibility \+ accessible primitives |
| LLM | Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Vercel AI SDK | Native streaming \+ tool calling; well-suited for financial summarization |
| Scheduling | Vercel Cron Jobs | First-party scheduler; Pro plan supports sub-daily frequency |
| Auth | Next.js middleware password gate | Single-user; full identity provider unnecessary |

## 4\. Recommended API Stack (Verified Pricing \-- May 2026\)

| Data Domain | Provider | Monthly Cost | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Macro / economic data (GDP, CPI, fed funds, treasury rates, yield curve, mortgages, retail sales, consumer sentiment, gold/silver/oil/gas commodities, housing data) | **FRED** | **Free** | 840,000 time series, 50+ years history available |
| US stocks, indices, ETFs, market cap, gainers/losers, watchlist | **Polygon Stocks Starter** | $29 | Unlimited REST calls, 5 yr historical, 15-min delayed |
| Cryptocurrency (BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA, XRP) | **CoinGecko Hobbyist** | $35 | Covers all five tokens, real-time |
| News (optional, for Koyfin-style news panel) | **MarketAux** or **Finnhub** free tier | Free | 5,000+ sources |
| Deep intraday minute history (optional, only if minute-granularity history is required beyond 5 yr) | **EODHD All World Extended** | \~$33 | 1-min US equities from 2004 (\~22 yrs) |
| LLM (chat \+ 2 daily summaries) | **Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6** | \~$10–30 | Usage-based; estimated for typical single-user load |
| Hosting | **Vercel Pro** | $20 | Required for sub-daily cron |
| Database | **Supabase** | $0–25 | Free tier likely sufficient initially |

**Estimated total monthly run-cost: \~$95–150**

Bloomberg Terminal is excluded from this stack: at $31,980/year per seat, it is not appropriate for a single-user personal dashboard unless an existing Terminal subscription is already in place.

## 6\. Rough Time Estimate

**\~7–9 weeks**. This estimate is indicative and subject to final confirmation of the open items in §8. A firm timeline will be issued once those items are resolved and scope is locked.

| Phase | Duration | Scope |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1\. Foundation | \~1 week | Project scaffolding, Vercel \+ Supabase setup, auth gate, base layout |
| 2\. Data ingestion | \~1–2 weeks | FRED, Polygon, CoinGecko integrations; historical backfill; per-minute polling jobs |
| 3\. Dashboard UI | \~2 weeks | Multi-panel layout, all metric panels, watchlist, top gainers/losers |
| 4\. Drill-down \+ charts | \~1 week | Per-ticker detail pages, time-range chart components |
| 5\. AI features | \~1 week | LLM chatbot (streaming) \+ scheduled morning \+ afternoon summary jobs |
| 6\. Polish, QA & handoff | \~1–2 weeks | Performance tuning, responsive QA, deployment, documentation |

**Range drivers:**

- **\~7 weeks (lower bound):** Scope trimmed during clarification \-- e.g., daily-only history, fewer metrics, lighter LLM features  
- **\~9 weeks (upper bound):** Full scope as defined in §1, including drill-down ticker pages, watchlist, and refined Koyfin-style polish

**Estimate assumes:**

- Scope is locked before Phase 1 begins  
- All API accounts (Polygon, CoinGecko, Anthropic, Vercel, Supabase) are provisioned before Phase 2  
- Review feedback at phase milestones returned within 2–3 business days  
- No mid-build provider changes or scope additions

## 7\. Technical Constraints

These are factual platform/data limits to be aware of \-- not opinions or risks.

1. **Per-minute intraday history depth.** Per-minute granularity is commercially capped at \~22 years for US equities (EODHD), \~4 years on Twelve Data, and shorter for non-US instruments. Daily granularity for 30–50 years is fully available via FRED, Polygon, and others.  
2. **Polygon $29 tier.** REST data on this tier is 15-minute delayed. Sufficient for per-minute polling on a single-user dashboard. True tick-level real-time would require their $199/month WebSocket plan.  
3. **Vercel Cron timing precision.** Cron jobs may execute anywhere within their scheduled hour (e.g., a 9:30 AM job may fire 9:30–9:59 AM). Acceptable for paragraph-style summaries; not suitable for tick-level synchronization.  
4. **TimescaleDB on Supabase Postgres 17\.** The `timescaledb` extension is deprecated in projects on Postgres 17\. Mitigation: use Postgres 15, or use plain Postgres tables (data volume here does not require Timescale).  
5. **Koyfin design reference.** Koyfin's terms protect their software and visual IP. Layout and conceptual inspiration is acceptable; pixel-level cloning of their visual design is not. Build on the framework concept with a distinct visual identity.  
6. **VIX historical depth.** VIX data is available from January 2, 1990 (\~36 years). Pre-1990 data does not exist.  
7. **Cryptocurrency historical depth.** Maximum available history per token: BTC \~16 yr, XRP \~13 yr, ETH \~11 yr, ADA \~9 yr, SOL \~6 yr. 30–50 yr crypto history does not exist.  
8. **IEX Cloud unavailable.** IEX Cloud was discontinued on August 31, 2024\. Polygon is the recommended substitute for the equity data IEX previously served.  
9. **Koyfin has no public API.** Data must be sourced from each underlying provider (FRED, Polygon, CoinGecko, etc.) and assembled fresh \-- direct integration with Koyfin is not possible.

## 8\. Open Items Requiring Client Confirmation

Items that need clarification before final scope lock:

1. **Bloomberg Terminal.** Confirm whether an existing Terminal subscription is in place. If not, Bloomberg will be dropped from the stack (FRED \+ Polygon cover the equivalent data). \- No existing subscription.   
2. **Historical granularity.** Confirm whether the 50-year requirement is for daily granularity (fully feasible) or per-minute granularity (capped at \~22 years). Daily granularity should be fine for this   
3. **Stock universe.** Confirm the universe for "top 10 gainers/losers" and "top 10 by market cap" \-- S\&P 500, Russell 1000, or all US-listed equities. (Affects API call volume and potentially cost tier.) All US equities would be better for both but if too difficult then S\&P 500 is fine.  
4. **Global Economy section.** This was listed as a category heading in the metric inventory but no metrics were specified beneath it. Confirm desired metrics or remove the section.   
   - US dollar index (DXY), 10-year US treasury yield, Yield curve (10Y-2Y), Global Manufacturing PMI, China Manufacturing PMI, High Yield Credit Spreads, Global Liquidity Index  
5. **Time zone / market hours.** Confirm operating time zone (assumed US Eastern) \-- affects the trigger times for the morning and afternoon AI summary jobs. \- US Eastern

## 9\. Summary

The project is technically feasible end-to-end. All data, infrastructure, and AI capabilities required are available through mature, commercially supported providers at the price points listed. The recommended stack is standard, well-documented, and supports both the per-minute refresh and the LLM analysis features. Once the open items in §8 are confirmed, scope can be locked and the build can proceed.
